fact: SMART Zambia's e-Government Division trained 146 public officers in three Southern Province districts (40 Gwembe, 46 Mazabuka, 60 Siavonga) in digital literacy, cybersecurity, Outlook and data protection.

SMART Zambia Institute launched a digital skills training-of-trainers programme in Ndola on 12 January 2026 for 80 beneficiaries mainly from public sector institutions, who are to pass skills on within their institutions.

TechAfrica News reports SMART Zambia Institute launched a decentralised digital skills training programme for the public service on its Cisco Networking Academy platform, starting with an orientation of 13 officers from seven institutions.
